advice.claim: Position a product as a multi-functional solution to justify a higher price point by highlighting how many individual products it replaces.
advice.quote: the price point is 280 dollars and here's why this is the bottle that replaces five separate products a primer bronzer moisturizer light enhancer and aftercare

advice.claim: When a customer declines a premium all-in-one product, pivot to selling standard products by highlighting the specific benefits and risks of using the wrong products for specific areas like the face.
advice.quote: so if they didn't go with what i'm performing um i would show them just your regular tanning lotion and then i would talk to them about a facial tanner the importance of it you shouldn't put any typical body lotion on your face just because it can clog the pores and make you break break out
